rationale: Three pooled-variance Gaussian prototypes, computed directly from cultivar means and within-class sample spreads in standardized chemistry coordinates. The Gaussian quadratic term common to all cultivars cancels, leaving a linear softmax head with w_kj=mean_kj*precision_j and b_k=log(smoothed prior_k)-sum(mean_kj^2*precision_j)/2. All 13 chemicals contribute. Alcohol/proline favor cultivar 1 versus 2, and low flavanoids/OD280/hue with high color intensity and malic acid favor cultivar 3. Correlated total phenols and proanthocyanins receive half evidence, nonflavanoid phenols 0.65 and OD280 0.8 to reduce duplicated phenolic evidence. Variances are 90% pooled within-class variance plus 10% unit variance and inflated 1.25x for conservative uncertainty. Missingness weights are zero because support is complete. No optimization or parameter search; only means, variances, counts, and a fixed chemistry/correlation-based evidence allocation.
